recentItems.description:
Watch "Jab Raja Met Sumi" New Hindi Action Movie (नई हिंदी मूवी) starring Jisshu Sengupta, Tapas Paul, Rachana Banerjee, Biswajit Chakraborty.

Film : Jab Raja Met Sumi
Language : Hindi
Genre : Romantic
Producer : Kaushik Bera
Director : Raj Mukherjee
Story : Raj Mukherjee
DOP : Debasish Roy
Fight : Shantanu Pal
Cast : Jisshu Sengupta, Tapas Paul, Rachana Banerjee, Biswajit Chakraborty, Gita Dey, Manoj Mitra, Anamika Saha, Parthasarathi Deb, Samata Das, Sandipa Bandyopadhyay.

Watch Now!!!
► Blockbuster Action Hindi Movies 2017 :: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLmwkIGIOUxQdFbwXQB6sPayvWM6I5ouzY
► Mission Aatank | New Hindi Movie 2017 : https://youtu.be/tlj2pE5VYf0

Synopsis ::
‘Jab Raja Met Sumi’ is a love story. Sumi’s parents are killed by Tony and his men and he is taken to Shakuni’s den where she is saved by Vikram. Vikram is jailed on false accusations of killing Tony. He escapes from jail. But Sumi tells him about her love for Raja. Raja is a poor guy who lies to Sumi that he is rich. Sumi severe ties with him when she finds out but Raja wins back her heart. In the mean time a rich girl Puja suffering from blood cancer falls in love with Raja. Raja pretends to love her against his wishes as Puja’s father requests him. Vikram kills Tony and avenges Sumi’s parents’ death. Puja finds out Raja’s truth, she unites Raja and Sumi and leaves her property in his name before she dies.
